afterword: **Correction (18 October).** This gate ran both arms on the candidate's engine. From this gate on, `tools/model_gate.py` put its own tree ahead of the checkout under test, so the standing arm imported omni-v9's code too. omni-v9 changed three files (`OMNI_V8.json` against `OMNI_V9.json`): the CityLearn runner, the realms harness (`realms/harness.py`) and the interval table (`omnicompass/student_t.py`). No module the cluster, conveyance or verdict models run imports any of them, so both checkouts would have run the same code in every model, and the reading above, identical on every model, holds by construction all the same. The gate is repaired: the checkout under test comes first, every worker names the tree its engine came from, and a reading taken on the wrong tree is refused (`results/model_gate/V11_VS_V10.md` is the first gate run that way).
